notes: Read the full 98-line numbered source before editing. Imports L1-4: useCallback/useState from 'react' (L1) are kept (React added for the classic jsx runtime used by the sibling Badge/FullscreenButton ports); react-i18next useTranslation (L2) -> a local useTranslation fallback hook returning {t} with the same call shape (no react-i18next in apps/native deps; t(key, fallback) resolves to the inline English fallback); lucide-react Printer (L3) -> a monochrome Unicode glyph '\u2399' (PRINT SCREEN SYMBOL) rendered in AppText (no lucide on native, matching the FullscreenButton glyph approach); Button + type ButtonProps from './Button' (L4) -> the web ghost button host is NOT ported, the visual is reproduced directly with a react-native Pressable + AppText (rule 5), and ButtonProps['variant'|'size'] are replaced by locally-declared ButtonVariant/ButtonSize unions with identical member names so the prop contract is faithful.

Module doc L6-20 (PrintButton opens window.print() for the current page, pairs with the @media print block, rendered in PageContainer actions, carries data-print-hide so it is hidden on the printed page, and the beforePrint flush-then-one-animation-frame contract) is ported into the native file header and re-framed for React Native (rules 4/7): window.print and @media print are DOM-only and UNAVAILABLE on true native, so the port makes that explicit — performPrint() returns false on native and the onUnavailable callback fires, while under react-native-web the real window.print is invoked verbatim. data-print-hide / @media print have no native analog and are documented as omitted.

PrintButtonProps L21-41 ported field-for-field with JSDoc preserved: label?:string (L22-23), iconOnly?:boolean (L24-25), beforePrint?:()=>void|Promise<void> (L26-31), variant?:ButtonProps['variant'] (L32-33) -> variant?:ButtonVariant (default 'ghost'), size?:ButtonProps['size'] (L34-35) -> size?:ButtonSize (default 'sm'), ariaLabel?:string (L36-37), disabled?:boolean (L38-39), className?:string (L40) retained for source-compat but ignored on native (destructured as _className). Three native-only props are added for parity consumers: style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle> (merged onto the Pressable), testID (native test/automation hook mapping the web button host), and onUnavailable?:()=>void (the rule-7 explicit-unavailable escape hatch invoked when there is no window.print).

Component signature + destructure L43-52 ported verbatim with identical defaults (iconOnly=false, variant='ghost', size='sm'); className renamed _className; style/testID/onUnavailable added. const { t } = useTranslation() (L53) preserved via the local fallback hook. const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false) (L54) preserved with identical state names. const printLabel = label ?? t('common.printButton.print', 'Print') (L56) preserved verbatim incl. the i18n key + 'Print' English fallback.

handleClick L58-79 ported with the control flow preserved exactly: the printing re-entrancy guard `if (printing) return` (L59), setPrinting(true) (L60), the awaited optional beforePrint() (L62-64), the requestAnimationFrame one-paint-cycle deferral (L65-74) -> scheduleFrame() which uses the global rAF when present (RN + react-native-web) and falls back to a microtask in runtimes/tests without frame scheduling so setPrinting(false) still runs (same shape as the useLogStream frame-scheduler port); inside it the try/finally (L69-73) is preserved with window.print() (L70) -> performPrint() (global print when present, else returns false and fires onUnavailable — the explicit unavailable state for native) and setPrinting(false) in finally (L72); the catch logging console.error('PrintButton: beforePrint failed', err) + setPrinting(false) (L75-78) is preserved verbatim. useCallback deps [beforePrint, printing] (L79) extended to [beforePrint, printing, onUnavailable] for the added callback (exhaustive-deps).

resolvedAriaLabel L81 ported verbatim: ariaLabel ?? (iconOnly ? printLabel : undefined). Render L83-97 -> a Pressable reproducing the ghost button: Button type='button' (L85) form semantics have no native analog and are omitted; variant (L86) -> the variants map (primary bg-blue-600/hover-700 text-white; secondary dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-100; outline transparent + border dark:border-gray-600; danger bg-red-600/hover-700 text-white; ghost transparent + colors.surfaceHover pressed tint, inherited text -> colors.textSecondary); size (L87) -> the sizes map (sm h-8 px-3 text-xs=32/12/12; md h-10 px-4 text-sm=40/16/14; lg h-12 px-6 text-base=48/24/16; auto density-aware -> default comfortable 40/16/14) + base rounded-md=6, gap-2=8, items/justify-center, font-medium=500, disabled:opacity-50; onClick={handleClick} (L88) -> onPress={handleClick}; icon={<Printer className='h-3.5 w-3.5'/>} (L89, 14px) -> an always-rendered AppText '\u2399' glyph at fontSize 14 in the variant text colour.

Accessibility + remaining attrs L90-95: disabled (L90) -> Pressable disabled + accessibilityState.disabled + opacity 0.5; aria-label={resolvedAriaLabel} (L91) -> accessibilityLabel={resolvedAriaLabel} with identical resolution (visible label supplies the name when not iconOnly); data-print-hide (L92) is a web @media-print hide affordance with no React Native analog and is intentionally omitted (documented in the header); className (L93) -> dropped (cn unused on native), the native style prop is merged instead; children {iconOnly ? null : printLabel} (L95) -> the label AppText is rendered only when !iconOnly (the printer icon always renders, matching the web icon+children order). Closing JSX/function (L96-98) maps to the Pressable/component close; PrintButton.displayName='PrintButton' is set and a default export added for native ergonomics.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, react-i18next, cn, or old web UI components are imported (rule 4): only React + react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet + type StyleProp/TextStyle/ViewStyle) and the existing apps/native theme tokens + AppText primitive (rule 5). window.print / requestAnimationFrame are accessed via the established `globalThis as typeof globalThis & {...}` typed-probe pattern used by useLogStream and other native parity files. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint @react-native) exit 0; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles -> all existing suites pass (no regressions).
